summary: Withdraw or decline a person handoff through authenticated client actions

replay.detail: Uses the existing durable work.handoff-returned transition and canonical projection without changing replay semantics.

schema.detail: Adds work.withdraw-handoff and work.decline-handoff client actions with exact target, message, bounded reason and work fence. Generated clients include typed parameters and methods.

rules.detail: Only the handing agent withdraws; only the assigned person declines, never a delegated assistant. Generic person handoff, claim and release remain unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Adds authenticated withdraw and decline actions with typed exact-note and work-fence refusals. Returning work neither completes it nor acknowledges the note. Existing generic person work operations are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No additional interruption beyond normal daemon and client replacement.

manual.detail: No data conversion or configuration change is required.

recovery.detail: Existing durable disposition retries and client action receipts retain their recovery semantics. Older servers do not expose these new actions.
